input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.
outdir.help_text: Can be any name you choose, without space characters and ideally without any special characters

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

timestamp.description: Timestamp used to name the trace, report, timeline and DAG files. Set automatically at launch.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

custom_config.description: A path to a custom configuration file.

go.description: A path to a directory containing a hash file for each species in the analysis.

chromopaint.description: Chromopaint run by default (but you can turn it off)

tree.description: A path to a file containing a phylogenetic tree for all species in Newick format.

hex.description: A path to a file containing a singular, unique hex code on each line to be used when painting chromosomes.

lifted.description: Choose whether to use the lifted anchor filter (from last)

score.description: Calculate synteny scores for each species.

chromo_lengths.description: Calculate length in bp of each chromosome.

proportional_chromosomes.description: Plot chromosomes at sizes proportional to their actual genome sizes, so that larger genomes appear wider than smaller ones.

cutoff.description: Cut off for GO analysis. Integer for percentage of top and bottom genes to test (default = 10)

cutoffdistance.description: Cut off distances for GO analysis. Integer/s for number genes close to breaks (default = 1,2)

gffread_coding.description: Choose whether to run only with coding genes or not (default is all genes)

ribbon.description: If you want to plot a ribbon plot for selected species

jcvi_ortholog_arguments.description: Optionally change the flags of the jcvi ortholog line, which runs variants of last

jcvi_screen_arguments.description: Optionally change the screen flags of jcvi, which sets the minimum number of genes in a syntenic block to plot

algo_options.title: ALGO subworkflow options (--mode algo)
algo_options.description: Ancestral linkage group (Syngraph) and ancestral gene order (AGORA) reconstruction from BUSCO single-copy orthologues. Only used when --mode algo is set; the default pairwise workflow ignores these.

mode.description: Set to 'algo' to run the ALGO subworkflow instead of the default pairwise synteny workflow.

species_tree.description: Path to a Newick species tree covering every species in --input, used by both Syngraph and AGORA. Required unless --iqtree_species_tree is set to build one instead.

busco_lineage.description: BUSCO lineage dataset to use in genome mode, e.g. coleoptera_odb12.

exclude_scaffolds.description: Optional TSV of species<TAB>scaffold_name rows to drop before Syngraph/AGORA (e.g. unlocalised scaffolds or a Y chromosome).

syngraph_m.description: Syngraph -m: minimum number of markers required to support a rearrangement.

syngraph_r.description: Syngraph -r: rearrangement model (2 = fissions/fusions only, 3 = adds reciprocal translocations).

syngraph_reference.description: Syngraph -s: reference taxon (must match one of the species names in --input) used to record rearrangements.

agora_ancgenome_glob.description: Glob (relative to AGORA's output directory) matching its ancGenome output file(s), used by the fragmentation index step.

iqtree_species_tree.description: Build the species tree with OrthoFinder + IQ-TREE from the same genomes' proteomes, instead of supplying one via --species_tree. Exactly one of the two must be set.

iqtree_outgroup.description: Comma-separated tip name(s) (matching --input species names) to root the IQ-TREE species tree on. Omit for midpoint rooting. Only used with --iqtree_species_tree.

iqtree_args.description: Extra arguments appended to the IQ-TREE species-tree command line, e.g. '-mset LG,WAG,JTT' to restrict ModelFinder's candidate matrices. Only used with --iqtree_species_tree.

iqtree_partition_model.description: Model written per partition in the supermatrix partition file. 'AA' lets ModelFinder pick one per orthogroup; set e.g. 'LG+F+G4' to fix it and skip model selection. Only used with --iqtree_species_tree.

mafft_args.description: Arguments passed to MAFFT when aligning each single-copy orthogroup. Only used with --iqtree_species_tree.

orthofinder_args.description: Arguments passed to OrthoFinder. Defaults to the fast dendroblast method rather than the MSA-based default, since only the Orthogroups.tsv assignment is used (OrthoFinder's own gene trees/species tree are discarded in favour of the IQ-TREE supermatrix tree). Only used with --iqtree_species_tree.

orthofinder_v2.description: Use OrthoFinder 2.5.5 instead of the default vendored v3.x module, for machines where v3's biocontainers image doesn't run (e.g. arm64). Only used with --iqtree_species_tree.
